mechanism: Furosemide may reduce praziquantel efficacy through increased renal clearance and altered absorption, while praziquantel metabolism via CYP3A4 could be affected; furosemide-induced electrolyte depletion increases seizure risk in parasitic infections.
action: Monitor praziquantel efficacy closely; maintain adequate hydration and electrolyte balance during concurrent use; consider alternative antiparasitic if seizure control is compromised.
